pages.title: Cosmic Neutronium Singularity
pages.text: Cosmic neutronium compressed into a single point. It was already one of the densest materials I had, and now it is denser. The point is absolutely black and impossibly heavy, and space visibly dips toward it.
$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Cosmic neutronium is neutron-star matter enhanced further. I crushed it in the Singularity Compactor, and it collapsed into a single point almost too heavy to move.
$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Baryon Asymmetry.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
